primary.title: Sebi reintroduces open-market share buybacks: How your gains will be taxed and what to consider before participating
primary.summary: Sebi has notified rules for open-market share buybacks effective 1 August 2026, allowing companies to repurchase shares through stock exchanges. Here's how your capital gains will be taxed and what to consider before selling your shares via the open market.
